user_sees: Body text bigger (up to 1.6 times)
Headings up to 1.4 times, page titles 1.3 times, big numbers 1.2 times
Text wraps
must_not: A big number broken over two lines
A button pushed off the screen

user_sees: Each takes a finger tap of at least 48 dp
must_not: A miss on an icon's edge

user_sees: One spoken line like 'Recovery, 82 Primed, up 3'

steps.action: Make a mistake in a box
user_sees: The error line spoken once

user_sees: The bar appears without sliding

start: Phone font size above the app's cap

steps.action: Open a page with a big number and a ring
user_sees: Text grows no more than its cap; the number in the ring stays whole

steps.action: Turn 'Remove animations' on in phone settings, come back
user_sees: Movement stops at once, without restarting the app

steps.action: Turn it off again, come back
user_sees: Movement back
